response.justification: Bogdan demonstrates strong full-stack engineering experience and leadership in AI-agent infrastructure, including MCP protocols and agentic workflows, which aligns well with GenAI/Cloud requirements. However, his resume lacks explicit mentions of vector databases, RAG architectures, or multi-agent system frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI), which are key for this role. His Python experience is not prominently featured, and while he has cloud (AWS/GCP) exposure, it is not detailed. His leadership in technical discovery sessions is implied but not clearly documented.
strengths: Strong full-stack engineering background with expertise in TypeScript, Node.js, and cloud infrastructure (AWS CDK, Kubernetes)
Direct experience with AI-agent infrastructure, MCP protocols, and developer tooling relevant to GenAI workflows
Demonstrated leadership in open-source projects and mentoring (e.g., TDD, CI/CD practices, workshops)
concerns: No explicit mention of vector databases, RAG architectures, or multi-agent frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI) in the resume
Limited visible Python experience, which is a core requirement for this role
Cloud platform experience is mentioned but not detailed (e.g., no clear examples of building AI systems on AWS/GCP/Azure)
